page.notes: The page number reads "313" but the last digit is doubtful. The running head is decorated and only partly legible; I could not read it reliably. The line "obscurissima" appears split across lines without a printed hyphen, so I wrote it whole; the break may be an error. Possible printing errors: "eiusauditum" is printed without a space and I have read it as "eius auditum"; "fi re in / tegra" is read as "si re in integra" with the word split at the line end. The gathering signature is unclear and may be "x 2" or "x ă".
